# lander: a mesh for the world to draw in 3D. An old lander on four splayed legs (5.6 m across the footpads), the dark radiation vault on its deck, the propellant bay in gold, the dish and camera masts; the footprint centre at the origin, its footpads on z = 0. Weathered as it stands (sulphur crust on what faces up); kinds 0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp. credit: none: our own model (Darwin's Cat), no one else's assets
# lander.mesh: magic CBMESH1, uint32 vertices, uint32 indices; per vertex 40 B: float32 pos xyz (m, z up,
#   the footprint's centre on the ground at 0), float32 normal xyz, float32 uv, uint8 rgb (display sRGB),
#   uint8 kind (0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp), uint8 texture (0 none, else a row below), 3 pad;
#   then uint32 indices, 3 per triangle. A textured face: colour and alpha from the texture, cut under 0.5.
front -y
vertices 3207
triangles 1672
bytes 148360
